summary: The filing reports a private placement by REalloys Inc., issuing 7,017,540 common shares at $14.25 per share for gross proceeds of ~$100M. Clear Street LLC acted as sole placement agent; shares were sold to institutional/accredited investors under Section 4(a)(2)/Regulation D. Proceeds are for working capital and general corporate purposes. This is a routine capital raise, not a special situation—no acquisition, divestiture, tender offer, or strategic review. No deal terms or event-driven angle apply; the filing is an ordinary 8-K covering entry into a securities purchase agreement and unregistered sale.
